All tests pass. The implementation in `beer_song.go`:

- **`Verse(n)`** — returns an error for `n < 0 || n > 99`. Verse 0 uses the "no more bottles / go to the store" text; all other verses are built from two small helpers: `bottles(n)` renders the count ("99 bottles", "1 bottle", "no more bottles") and `taken(n)` renders "one" or "it" for the last bottle.
- **`Verses(start, stop)`** — validates the range (start ≤ 99, stop ≥ 0, start ≥ stop), then joins `Verse(start)` down to `Verse(stop)` with a blank line between verses and a trailing newline.
- **`Song()`** — just `Verses(99, 0)`.

`go test` and `go vet` are both clean.
